title: Director of Annual Giving and Engagement
bio: Erin Webb is a skilled fundraiser with over 10 years of mission driven advancement experience in education, museums and cultural institutions. In her role as director of annual giving and engagement, Webb acts as a strategic partner with faculty, administrators, and donors. Webb began her career as the Membership Coordinator at the deCordova Sculpture Park & Museum before accepting the role of Membership Manager for the Harvard Art Museums. She then worked with the Wellesley Fund, the Greenway Conservancy, and the Advent School in various leadership capacities. Webb earned her Bachelor of Arts degree in Art History from The University of Massachusetts at Amherst, Master of Arts in Art History from the University of Connecticut, and Master of Liberal Arts in Management from Harvard Extension School.
